title: Born in Puerto Rico
body: Computers and games were part of my life from the very beginning.

title: Raised on quarters
body: My dad’s arcades were my first playground: neon signs, cosmic carpet and a change machine that never slept. Galaga taught me patterns. Donkey Kong taught me patience. I was eight, and every game was a world to figure out.

media.alt: A packed 1980s arcade with Pac-Man, Galaga and Donkey Kong cabinets under neon signs

title: Puerto Rico to North Miami
body: We moved to the US and settled in North Miami, Florida. South Florida became home.

title: My first real PC
body: Computers came first. The rave was two years away.

title: Dishwasher, Boston Market
body: Hollywood, Florida. My first kitchen job, and the start of more than three decades on the line.

media.alt: A Boston Market restaurant under palm trees in South Florida

title: The Edge, Fort Lauderdale
body: My first rave. The music took me over and I started dancing to the beats. That day changed my life.

media.alt: The crowd on the dancefloor at The Edge, Fort Lauderdale

title: First synths
body: A Nord Lead and a Quasimidi Rave-O-Lution 309. I spent every penny I had on that thing.

media.alt: The Quasimidi Rave-O-Lution 309, a silver groovebox covered in knobs and blue buttons

title: Winter Music Conference at The Edge
body: Rabbit in the Moon leading the gathering. Nights with DJ Icey and DJ Sharpe. My friends from the club ate at my restaurants; my crews came out to The Edge.

media.alt: The Edge flyer, March 25, 1995, during Winter Music Conference: Rabbit in the Moon, Spacetime Continuum, Mixmaster Morris
The Edge flyer: DJ Icey, DJ Mot, Flux and the resident DJ Sharpe

title: My first website
body: It looked good on my computer. On a friend’s it took about 30 minutes to load.

title: Georgia, and Benjamin
body: A new state, and on December 1st my son Benjamin was born. Everything changed, in the best way.

title: Full Sail University
body: Audio engineering in Orlando.

media.alt: The Full Sail Studios entrance arch in Winter Park, Florida

title: Los Angeles
body: I went west for new kitchens and new flavors. LA gave me both, and something I didn’t see coming: film scores. Music that tells a story without saying a word.

title: 1,000 covers. Four cooks.
body: At Wolfgang Puck’s. The night I’ll never forget.

title: Back to South Florida
body: Geronimo’s Bar and Grill: line cook, assistant manager, bartender.

title: Executive chef, St. Augustine
body: Three successful restaurants. There is not one kitchen I will work in without music. It’s a necessity, not a want.

media.alt: Ray Burgos in a chef's apron at a kitchen counter with fresh vegetables

title: Now or never
body: I always wanted to build apps and never had the time. So I saved up and bought my time.

title: KeyMacro
body: My AI nutrition and training partner: meal plans and workouts off one plan, with Coach Key in your corner. Seven months from concept to first sale.

title: SlidePress
body: Built out of necessity: social posts used to take me three apps and hours. Now it’s ten minutes, everywhere at once. In production in two months.

title: Back in the studio
body: Threshold of Sound, Sonic Illusion, Dawn on the Loading Dock. I’ve stopped many times, but music always calls me back.

title: This hub
body: Every lane in one place.

title: POE Source
body: Gaming is another parallel highway in my life. POE Source is built to launch with Path of Exile 2 1.0 on December 11.
